workspace.label: Authored PrivacyBench review example — no provider run

protocol.title: Software receiving fixture — original native result intake
protocol.purpose: Exercise exact original result preservation. No benchmark or customer model was run.
protocol.scope: One authored native-shaped JSON input for software receiving.

criteria.label: gold
criteria.description: Original count of in-scope gold spans in this group.

criteria.label: detected
criteria.description: Original count of gold spans detected with the matching entity label and native-coordinate overlap.

criteria.label: coherent
criteria.description: Original count of detected gold spans with a changed replacement judged coherent.

criteria.label: incoherent
criteria.description: Original count of detected gold spans left identical or judged incoherent.

criteria.label: skipped
criteria.description: Original count of detected changed spans lacking a usable judge verdict; these remain in the detected denominator.

criteria.label: ner recall
criteria.description: Original detected/gold rate. Detection requires the producer label and native-coordinate overlap contract.

criteria.label: synthesis accuracy
criteria.description: Original coherent/detected rate. Identity mappings and unjudged detected spans do not become successful synthesis.

criteria.label: combined accuracy
criteria.description: Original coherent/gold rate. This includes detection misses in its original gold-span denominator.

limitations: Authored software receiving input; timestamps are fixture metadata, not an observed evaluation.
